messages.subject: renderDataTable - Help
parts:
Hi,

I´m trying to build a data table, but I had some problems. I have two things that are not working together:

1 – I´m using “bSearchable” to select 1 column that I want to use the search tool to filter
2 – I´m using "checkboxInput" to select the columns the user want see.

Both of them work separately, but not together.  If I uncheck a column in my menu input the data disappear, like applying a filter and no data were found.

Do you have any idea about how to fix it?

Thank you!!

Luis

ui.R
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  pageWithSidebar(
    headerPanel('Title'),
    sidebarPanel(
      helpText('Text about the table'),
      
      
      checkboxInput('columns','I want to select the columns' , value = FALSE),
      
      conditionalPanel(
        condition= "input.columns == true",
        checkboxGroupInput('show_vars', 'Select the columns that you want to see:', names(iris[1:4]),
                           selected =  names(iris[1:4]))
      ),
      
      
      downloadButton('downloadData', 'Download'),width = 3
      
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tags$head(tags$style("tfoot {display: table-header-group;}")),
      dataTableOutput("mytable1"),width = 9
      
    )
  ))
)

server.R
library(shiny)
library(ggplot2) 
library(XLConnect)



shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  
  
  #DATA 
  tabel<- reactive({
    iris[,c(input$show_vars,"Species"), drop = FALSE]
    
  })
  
  
  
  #   OUTPUT   
  output$mytable1 = renderDataTable({
    tabel()}, 
    options = list(    
      aoColumns = list(list(bSearchable = FALSE), list(bSearchable = FALSE),list(bSearchable = FALSE),
                       list(bSearchable = FALSE),list(bSearchable = TRUE)),
      bFilter=1, bSortClasses = 1,aLengthMenu = list(c(10,25,50, -1), list('10','25', '50', 'Todas')),iDisplayLength = 10
    )
    
    
    
  )
  
  
  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() { paste('tabela_PSU','.xlsx', sep='') },
    content = function(file){
      fname <- paste(file,"xlsx",sep=".")
      wb <- loadWorkbook(fname, create = TRUE)
      createSheet(wb, name = "Sheet1")
      writeWorksheet(wb, tabel(), sheet = "Sheet1") 
      saveWorkbook(wb)
      file.rename(fname,file)
    },
  )
  
  
  
})

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: renderDataTable - Help
parts:
That is because your DataTable options depends on the checkboxes,
which is not reflected in your code. To reflect the dependency, you
have to return the options via a function. Here is an example using
DataTables 1.10.2 (
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/-0u-wTnq_lA ):

renderDataTable(..., options = function() {
list(pageLength = 10, ...,
columnDefs = list(list(targets = seq_along(input$show_vars) -
1, searchable = FALSE))
})

It may take a while to understand it. It seems you want to disable the
search boxes for the first n -1 columns where n is the number of the
data. In this case, n = length(input$show_vars) + 1 (+1 because of the
Species column), so basically you want to disable the columns
1:length(input$show_vars), which I wrote as
seq_along(input$show_vars). Then the -1 part is due to JavaScript
indices start from 0 instead of 1, e.g. column 0 means the first
column, column 1 is the second, and so on.

Regards,
Yihui
